svg.title: Yaeai Reconnaissance Pinnace - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Small Craft Catalogue (2023), printed 84-85, PDF 85-86. Single-deck outer envelope retains rounded forward pod, two waisted side sections, broad central body and twin aft drive shoulders with open central stern notch. Illustration corroborates long podded hull. Its illustrated rear fins are omitted from the plan-based envelope because their horizontal span is not defined; detached weapons excluded.
